scope: Local application security boundaries; synthetic documents; no live model or cloud calls

checks: Instruction-like JSON remains data and unselected documents are excluded
Forged auth fields and wrong-origin requests cannot bypass route access
Source blocks are reconstructed and model action fields do not become actions
Forged complete flags, quotes, source identities and offsets cannot certify a report
Action-only output fails validation without tool execution

browser.server: Compiled Next.js production app on loopback port 3001

limitations: Hand-authored cases are not a representative security benchmark
No live model semantic prompt-injection resistance measured
No hosted auth, database gateway or infrastructure verified
Prior tests were not rerun solely to aggregate counts; new tests ran separately
